Degree attestation chain for Indian degrees (notary -> state HRD -> MEA -> Qatar Embassy -> MoFA Qatar) is from consultancy blogs only.
Whether the 2020 labour reforms (job mobility without NOC, exit-permit removal) still apply as-is in 2026 - not re-verified.

name: Qatar

languages.note: English widely used in private and semi-government tech roles (general observation, not sourced).

salary.note: low = Naukrigulf average QAR 12,559/month x 12 (~170 self-reported salaries); high = Qatar Living 2026 guide senior/lead engineer upper value QAR 40,000/month x 12 (guide range QAR 26,000-40,000/month, may be all-inclusive). PayScale average QAR 177,965 (2026); Levels.fyi Doha median total comp QAR 263,441 (updated 2026-05-01). Check basic vs total package. Approximate, low confidence.

income_tax_note: No personal income tax on employment income (general knowledge, not re-verified this session).
cost_of_living_note: Housing is the main cost in Doha; packages usually include housing or an allowance (not sourced).

visa_routes.name: Employer-sponsored work visa and residence permit (via Qatar Visa Center in India)

salary_threshold.note: No minimum salary threshold found for a standard work visa.

visa_routes.degree_requirement: Employer obtains Ministry of Labour recruitment approval, then MOI work entry visa. Attested educational qualifications are typically required; regulated professions (healthcare, engineering, education) may need professional-authority approval.
visa_routes.three_year_indian_bachelors_note: Degree must be attested (reported chain: notary -> state HRD/education dept -> MEA -> Qatar Embassy -> MoFA Qatar). Whether an 'engineer' title requires an engineering degree for software roles was not confirmed; a BCA holder should prefer non-engineer titles (developer/programmer). Unverified.
visa_routes.processing_time: Few weeks to a few months end-to-end including attestation (secondary sources).
visa_routes.lottery_or_quota: No lottery; Qatarisation rules for private IT roles not confirmed.
visa_routes.path_to_pr: Standard work residence does not lead to PR; limited PR routes (investment QAR 3.65m with quotas; 'special competencies'); 10-year residency only for executives/entrepreneurs.
visa_routes.employer_cost_note: Employer applies and pays recruitment approval and visa; reported MOI fee QAR 300 (secondary). Candidate usually pays for attestation and police clearance. MoL Decision 61 of 2026 (Official Gazette 2026-10-25) tightens licensing of recruitment offices.

visa_routes.name: 10-year residency for executives and entrepreneurs

salary_threshold.note: QAR 50,000/month for chairman/C-suite; QAR 80,000 for other executive director titles. Not open to general professionals - not realistic for a senior IC engineer.

visa_routes.three_year_indian_bachelors_note: Not applicable to typical senior engineers.

sponsor_register.name: No public sponsor register found
sponsor_register.how_to_use: Any licensed Qatari establishment with recruitment approval can sponsor; no public list to match against.

negative: candidates currently in the country only

ease_for_indian_nationals.rationale: English-friendly market with a large Indian community and a streamlined India-side process through Qatar Visa Centers (biometrics, medicals, contract signing). The tech market is smaller than UAE/Saudi and long-term residence options are limited to executives/investors.

factors.degree_recognition: Attested degree required; 3-year degree treatment unconfirmed.
factors.quota_or_lottery: No lottery; Qatarisation impact on IT unconfirmed.
factors.employer_willingness: Moderate; smaller pool of tech employers.
factors.attestation_or_paperwork: Multi-step attestation plus QVC biometrics/medical in India.

relocation_norms: Employer sponsors the visa; packages may be quoted as basic or all-inclusive (Qatar Living warns to check). Housing, flights and schooling not sourced.

scam_warnings: If anyone asks you to pay recruitment fees or 'mandatory QVC processing fees', verify through official channels before paying.
Recruitment offices must be licensed under MoL Decision 61 of 2026; ask for the office's licence.
Any request for money (visa fee, processing fee, 'deposit', medical or 'security' fee) before or after an offer is a red flag; MOHRE states genuine employers cover all recruitment costs.
Offers that ask you to travel or start work on a visit/tourist visa: visit visas do not permit work; India's MEA says a genuine offer must allow emigration on an employment/work visa.

Unregistered Indian recruiting agents: MEA advisories report job seekers cheated by unregistered agents, with overcharging of roughly Rs 2-5 lakh; check the agent's licence number on the eMigrate 'List of active RA' (https://emigrate.gov.in/ext/raList.action).
A genuine overseas offer (per MEA) carries an employment contract signed by the foreign employer, the recruitment agent and the worker.
MEA (Aug 2023) warned that some agents misused foreign employers' eMigrate logins to generate fake offers, so an eMigrate-looking document alone is not proof.

App-detectable signals: fee/deposit keywords ('processing fee', 'visa charges', 'refundable deposit'), free-mail recruiter domains (gmail/yahoo/outlook) claiming to be a large company, WhatsApp/Telegram-only contact, no company name or address, salary far above market, 'immediate hiring, no interview', early requests for passport scans or bank details, and 'free visa' / 'visa for sale' wording ('فيزا حرة', 'إقامة حرة').
